notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

 Fixed Arena Enemy Spawns which sometimes spawned under the ground
 Fixed farm exit often being unreachable on dysfunction
 Dysfunctionator won't rotate some meshes
 fixed level select numbers being wrong
 Fixed keypads being able to have game-crashing text length
 Fixed dialogue having no spacialization after a respawn
 Made orange keys more distinguishable from yellow
 Replaced key boxes in factory with new ones that should open more consistently
 Hopefully fixed sometimes getting stuck after exiting the dream in factory 2
 Key tubs no longer rely on "child actors" (the Macaulay Culkin bug)
 Fix for gamemode not saving after recent changes

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Patch notes:


General Fixes:

 Fixed Discharger spamming ammo pickup/fail notifs when plugged in.
 Fixed many achievements not working.
 Fixed human's limbs sometimes BONKing them if detached with the guitar, causing extra damage.
 Fixed a crash caused by invalid collision check on game load.
 Optimised performance-heavy projectiles when used in full-auto weapons during the dream sequence.
 Hopefully fixed Taurissan key tubs not opening on lower framerates.
 Fixed being able to lock yourself inside a Factory secret area.
 Fixed being able to clip inside the Factory blast door and get stuck.
 Fixed Boomer Juice being vegan, despite containing goat by-products.
 Picture frames will no longer collide with the player after they are broken.
 Fixed eating a cooked empty mug being a vegan infraction.
 Fixed Egg's bedroom door always falling inwards when starting Apartment level.
 Slightly improved Factory conveyor puzzle on lower framerates.
 Fixed being able to sequence-break the Factory conveyor puzzle and get stuck.
 Turned off mipmaps for a few textures that include crucial text.
 Fixed not being able to pick up the Fertilauncher at the beginning of Farm if you have found one early and have full ammo.
 Fixed vehicles continuing to fully accelerate away from you for 1.2 seconds after exiting while holding accelerate. 
 Fixed firing a weapon in a car wasting your ammo.
 Fixed being able to fire your gun while looking at a CCTV screen.
 Fixed the door that opens after the Sewer Depths boss fight being closed if you load game.
 Fixed weapon-giving arena cards stating that enemies will drop ammo if the weapon does not have ammo, and NOT stating they'll drop ammo if the weapon DOES have ammo.
 Fixed zombie blood appearing as vomit in a blender funnel.
 Fixed a crash caused if the incremental achievement save gets corrupted.
 Fixes for inventory screen scaling on non-16:9 screen ratios.
 Fixes for extension cord reliablity.
 Fixed Taurissan not counting as an enemy.
 Fixed GO button on New Game not having a sound.
 Fixed a whole bunch of issues regarding the registering of enemy deaths.
 Fixed Factory ending not actually killing everything.
 Fixed inventory tooltips being able to go off screen.
 Hopefully fixed being able to sequence-break the end of Farm.
 Fixed incorrect invisible walls in Cumbubblingham.
 Added a checkbox on New Game to optionally delete all your collectables and start fully fresh.
 Level select warning text modified to correctly represent how achievements are handled when not starting from level 1.
 Removed third-person mode.
 Removed Pisstol from Sheffie and PISSCO level select areas.
 Added more fan art.
 Fixed killing baby flies being vegan.
 Fixed various USE prompts showing E as the use key regardless of config.


Arena fixes and changes:

 Removed bleach round on wave 4 of arena level 1.
 Nerfed bleach pootank in arena mode.
 Fixed the card for unlocking next arena not having the right image.
 Nerfed enemy "Hasty Pootanks" card.
 Nerfed enemy health regen card.
 Nerfed increase max health card.
 Nerfed Builder's Tea card.
 Fixed death screen sometimes telling you to "try flaccid mode" even though there's no difficulties in arena.
 Exploding fireworks packs now do siginificantly less damage to egg.
 Improvements to enemy navigation and collision on Arena map 2.
 Added Kill-Zs to arena maps.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

 Fixed stuttering when moving the mouse for some users.
  Fixed coins not showing up in arcade if you had them.
  Made inventory items complain less about assets not existing.
 Added eggs to GFX menu sliders.
 Gunbase will now allow you to pick up duel wieldable guns that you already own one of even if you have full ammo.
 Removed collectables from test levels.
 Added missing application icon.
 Fixed dysfunction being laggy on maps with conveyor belts.
 Cumfaces and Sperm projectiles should now trigger the Salty Surprise achievement.
 Made cultist voices a bit louder.
 Fixed uddertaker stow-while-charged exploit
 Game is now 64bit instead of 32bit.
 Removed "Playtest" from version info.
 Fixed some bugs and slowdowns related to fires.
 Human limbs no longer spawn spurts on begin play but only on "start".
 Musky Husky no longer works underwater.
 Dysfunction now removes invisible walls, and randomises food effects.
 Removed Crossbowner bouncy projectile from fast firing dysfunction projectilelist.
 Buffed shotgun alt fire impact damage and range.
 Factory ruins blood pool will now damage the same on all difficulties.
 Added fall-back to end of level, now all already unlocked incremental achievements are given again (in-case  steam didn't catch them the first time).
 Added mouse Y inverting to controls menu.
 Fixed visible applicator projectile collision sphere
 Fixed opened shutter doors taking full duration to re-open on a game load.
 Added missing image for "Biblically-Accurate Ball of Tummy-Chunks" Aged Parchment.

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCISION release, new games in the catalog, and more Realms Deep 2023 news from Hyperstrange
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/1699b1f20e514af85e9d00ea02a216d728938311.png

Hyperstrangers!

It is that time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers!
[previewyoutube=qlgqps4wcbU;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734680/INCISION/
Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement
[previewyoutube=xoMT9iW_690;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/
POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude! 

Blood West - Chapter 2 announcement
[previewyoutube=ll6tFR5ebg4;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West
Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

Supplice - release date announcement
[previewyoutube=2YS2ZCjBTnw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice/
According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: 30 march 2023!

77p Egg: Eggwife - new game announcement
[previewyoutube=OXD0zCu0rJw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/
We fell in love with Eggwife after first seeing it in the Realms Deep 2021 showcase. Now, after we've released POSTAL: Brain Damaged it's perfectly clear, that the audience wants us to take things a step further. Or a lot of steps further. To go so far, that we'll end up in UK. Eggwife is what would happen if the Brits came up with POSTAL, but... it's so much more. An immersive sim? A dating sim? A shopping cart driver sim? You name it! Maybe just go wishlist it, and get the Demo for you to plau

GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement
[previewyoutube=qAiV6YUVacM;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/
We strive to bring overlooked, original titles to a broader audience. Sometimes originality isn't apparent at face value. What seems like an arena shooter with retro stylings happens to become a whole sprawling world full of adventure and danger. You can find out for yourself just what makes Ghostware so unique that it found its way to our hearts. We'e not sure of the release date yet with this one, but we do highly encourage you to wishlist it and take the available demo for a spin.

And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!

Your's truly,
